name: AutoBattler
description: v2.10.0: contact-avoidance fix #2 (seventh play-test feedback) -- in sparse/simple situations the bot could walk INTO a monster ("撞到怪物"), reproduced in the real game on the exact user loadout (survivor, Danger 5, 2x ghost flint, waves 1-3: all four collisions had an economy commitment active, e.g. heading to a tree 1446 px away while a baby triceratops was 13 px away; the same run with --arb-econ=0 had none). Two defects: (1) the contact price saturates inside the (hurtbox-inflated) body radius, so once a body is that close the threat term has no escape gradient; v2.6.1 kept committed pulls safe with a binary body gate (acquire only when the nearest body is >320 px, abort inside 170 px) which v2.7 replaced with a route-risk budget whose maintain path never re-checks current bodies, and v2.8/v2.9 raised reward values and pull magnitudes (up to 28.8 HP), so committed objective pulls walked straight through bodies. Fixed with --arb-pullsafe (default 1): while any contact/dash body is inside its taper band, every objective pull (committed goal pull, bounty pull and the per-step reward attraction) is damped to zero and the contact/crowding terms decide the heading alone, with hysteresis on release; --arb-pullsafe=0 is the exact v2.9.1 arm. (2) the wave-end deadline factor was applied TWICE (economy.gd price x econ_planner deadline -> up to 9x), inflating lost-at-horn fruits and trees near the horn (real-game BOTLOG: tree value 14.02 vs base 3.0), so end-of-wave sweeps could outbid the contact price even on ordinary builds. Fixed with --arb-econdl (default 0): econ_planner is the single deadline owner; --arb-econdl=1 restores the v2.9.1 double scaling exactly. Verification: offline closed-loop repros go from 1 hit/hp 94 to 0 contact with the item still collected; new tracked tests/contact suite (fixed arm 0 contact on all fixtures with resources still collected, exact-v2.9.1 arm reproduces the bump, deadline unit probe 12/12); all existing offline suites pass. Real-machine A/B before the fix: the exact user loadout had 4/4 commitment-active collisions (the same build with --arb-econ=0 had 0/1 non-committed); real-machine A/B AFTER the fix is still pending (Steam was in another game session during the fix window; the bump-telemetry harness, scenarios and candidates are prepared under _research/round7/realgame for the next run). Exact v2.9.1 behaviour = --arb-pullsafe=0 --arb-econdl=1. v2.9.1: real-game hotfix -- v2.9.0's world_view failed to LOAD in the actual game: `"nb_of_waves" in RunData` is a PARSE error in the mod-loader compile context (the offline stub parse gate missed it), so the autopilot silently never moved ("纯挂机"). Fixed with runtime-safe Object.get(); added tests/tools/static_guard.py to the offline gate to forbid the whole class of autoload `in` probes. Real-game smoke (2.9.1 build, 4 runs, both --arb-econ arms) moves with move_ratio 0.90-0.93 and clears the waves. v2.9.0: economy objective layer (review-v3) -- the bot now prices every ground resource by HOW it is acquired: AUTO_AT_HORN (gold/fruit/boxes/mutation fruit/meca parts: the horn vacuum pays them anyway, so only mid-wave pickup-trigger value can justify a detour), LOST_AT_HORN (meca/mutant fruit, Veteran fruit: full value + wave-end deadline), MID_WAVE_ONLY (temp/decaying stats and consume-explosions that the horn does NOT trigger), TREE (an unfelled tree is destroyed at the horn, so it gets an expected-value price and deadline urgency) and SPECIAL targets (legacy value table). Food value now uses the real flat heal (3 + consumable_heal, clamped) instead of 2.5*missing_hp, killing the 10x over-value and the phantom healing on Vampire-like builds; full-HP permanent-stat payoffs are priced as the small 'one wave earlier' increment (the horn grants them too); boxes no longer cause mid-wave detours for their item choice (it is banked at the horn), only their immediate heal; gold pickup triggers (damage/reload/heal/double/material value/item-box gold, including the weapon-level reload) are priced. Rewards are gathered over the whole arena and planned by one continuous risk-budget planner (value - risk_weight(hp)*route_risk - eta_cost) with a hard HP floor, replacing the binary safe-window gate for economy candidates; special targets keep the v2.7 bounty path. --arb-econ=0 is the exact v2.8.0 control arm (no extra tuple fields, no planner). STRUCTURE: single steering/contract.gd (tuple schema/vocabulary) + steering/config.gd (one --arb-* parser for all keys; the old sweep/orbit keys keep their old semantics and the granular --arb-bladeunion/--arb-sweepmat/--arb-orbitscan/--arb-orbitw splits are available); new steering/economy.gd + steering/econ_planner.gd modules; player_movement_behavior.gd shrunk 356->123 lines (dead potential-field controller removed). v2.8.0: high-value coverage + live attack CD sync (fifth play-test feedback) -- Boss and Elite are priced apart (class 1 = 50 / class 4 = 30, x --arb-bounty) and produces are tagged and valued explicitly at reward tuple index 6 (normal crate 20, legendary crate 34, evolution consumable 20, loot alien 12, tree 7; valued max(raw, table); healing fruit keeps its raw food value, poison/revive zones/gold intentionally excluded). For fire_still kits the tap-move now stops exactly ONE frame when a weapon is ready (live cooldown sync via world_view fire_wait_frames) instead of the fixed 2-move/2-stop cycle, with hop/pin/no-weapon fallbacks. --arb-dpsref=2 opts into a current_stats killability estimate (default stays 1). Opt-outs: --arb-cov (0 = exact v2.7.0) and --arb-tapcd (0 = exact v2.7.0); all 15 switches at 0 = exact v2.4.0. v2.7.0: unified opportunity planning (fourth play-test feedback) -- the v2.6 bounty/goal layers are replaced by one value-vs-route-risk planner: explicit values for special targets (boss/elite 30, spawner egg 40, cursed/evolved 18, x --arb-bounty), route damage estimated from the same threat model with allowed risk = value*(0.10+0.20*agg)+2*agg and HP floors 0.55/0.35/0.20, a 100-frame commitment with value-scaled pull (clamp(10+0.6*value,14,34) for targets, x1-2 for rewards) and a close-in candidate. world_view gathers special targets out to 900/1400/1600 px by --arb-agg (nearest 8 extras) and gives fleeing loot aliens a measured velocity (6th reward field, value 8) that the arbiter intercepts with two fixed-point iterations. Opt-outs: --arb-opp (0 = exact v2.6.1) and --arb-agg (risk dial, inert while opp=0); all 13 switches at 0 = exact v2.4.0. v2.6.1: contact-avoidance fix (third play-test feedback) -- the bot no longer drifts into a monster and orbits it: the crowding terms projected a chasing body with its frozen velocity and could price running away as MORE crowded than orbiting, so the bot held a stable orbit on top of one chaser taking contact hits; the projection now tracks outrunnable pursuers (--arb-roomtrack=0 rolls back). Also: a winding-up charger's frozen body is now priced (--arb-windup=0), and the contact reach can no longer under-estimate elites/bosses/DLC non-circle hitboxes (--arb-hitbox=0). Movement-only autopilot for Brotato (MIT fork of BOTato, tested on 1.2.0.1). Auto-moves/dodges/collects during waves; every decision stays manual. Behaviour priors are inferred from measured build traits (no per-character table needed). v2.6.0: space planning — retreats from the wall band before a crowd squeezes it shut, a weak open-floor potential against edge drift; bounty approach toward special targets (bosses/elites, spawner eggs, cursed/evolved); item crates priced as items and loot aliens worth a detour. v2.5.0: planning layer — pre-emptive breakout from a closing encirclement (future-freedom rollout + committed escape), committed high-value item goals (DLC evolution fruits, hurt fruit, trees) with a walk-on pickup fix and end-of-wave urgency; pursuit-aware second ply. All new behaviour has exact opt-out flags. v2.4.0: DLC-aware engage stances for cursed/evolved enemies + evolution item pickup. v2.3.0: ranged standoff, trees/hurt fruit, 2-ply planner + hit-adaptive caution. Toggle with Shift+Space.
